BrochureContent.Content:
David Ross Estate Agents your local property experts are proud to present new to the market for sale 93 Rutland Avenue. 

This beautiful 2 bedroom mid terrace home comes to the market in good condition and has recently been re-wired and re-plumbed.

Located on the outskirts of Crumlin and surrounded by a host of local amenities to include primary and secondary schools, shops, parks and sport facilities to mention but a few. The area is also well serviced with excellent public transport links to Dublin City centre and surrounding areas. The M50 and N7 motorways are also less than 10 minutes drive making for easy access to the greater Dublin area and surrounding counties. 

The property itself briefly consists Walled and gated front garden providing secure off street parking. Upon entering the property you are welcomed into an entrance hallway To the front of the property is a cosy and large  reception room with feature fireplace, wood flooring and leading into a large Fully fitted kitchen and dining room with ample storage in the built in cabinets.

To the rear of the property is a wonderful large, private and sunny garden the perfect spot to simply enjoy the long summer evenings.

Upstairs comprises of two large double bedrooms, one to the front and one to the rear.. There is also a fully tiled family bathroom

Viewing of this property is highly recommended as interest will be high

Viewing by appointment only.
